account: It is day 0, just after ten, and I am in the plaza for my scheduled market walk. So far I have no evidence of unusual town business. The secretary reported no correspondence or urgent reports, and Townsfolk 30 has just told me there is no news. Townsfolk 10 and 20 are also nearby. The secretary is now walking near the plaza, but I do not know her destination or purpose; I heard her speaking earlier without being able to make out the words. The only unresolved matter is my three o'clock tea appointment: the book names only a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank, without identifying the host or exact cottage. I returned the appointment book, saw the secretary take it, and asked her to verify those details. This appears to be ordinary appointment coordination, not evidence of anything suspicious. My remaining engagements are lunch at home at noon, office accounts at one, tea at three, office at four thirty, and home at seven.
